Who we are

Our story. Our identity.

A registered grassroots football club with its heart in Mabvuku and Tafara.

Who we are

A registered club with a community mission.

Mafera Football Club is a registered grassroots football development organisation, registered under the football governance framework of the Government of Zimbabwe and affiliated to ZIFA, CAF and FIFA.

The club was registered by the Registrar of Companies, Zimbabwe, on 27 May 2026 as Mafera Football Club (Private) Limited, Entity No. 115842A0252026.

What guides us

Purpose in every pass.

Our mission, objectives and the challenges we are here to address.

Our mission

To promote grassroots football development, coaching and community participation from Mabvuku and Tafara townships and surrounding areas, with competitive football that develops youth talent and safeguards young people from drugs, substance abuse, unemployment and crime.

Open to every boy and girl

A safe, inclusive pathway where every boy and girl aged 9–20 in local schools and communities can access coaching, mentorship, education support and career progression. We are also campaigning to attract female coaches and referees, building pipelines from local primary and secondary schools that keep girls engaged in football.

Our objectives

  • Run a football club and grassroots development in schools and communities, and organise youth leagues and tournaments
  • Promote and manage football activities and competitions at local, national and international levels
  • Provide structured training for youth aged 9 to 20
  • Scout and nurture talent for local and international opportunities
  • Work with schools, clubs and development partners
  • Uphold ZIFA, CAF and FIFA regulations
  • Align with the Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education and ZIFA on national football policy

Challenges we address

  • Little sustainable partnership for funding, materials and facilities
  • Ad-hoc training instead of continuous, long-term programmes with tactical continuity and sports science support
  • Socio-economic hardship and rising youth substance abuse
  • No proper development compensation when nurtured players turn professional
  • Very few functional pitches
Leadership

The people behind the club.

The executive team guiding Mafera FC.

Chairperson

Prof Wenceslaus Mudyanadzo

Scholar and governance expert with 15 years of high-level diplomatic service and over 23 years in strategic leadership, governance and academia. African Union Governance Expert and Member of the Institute of Directors of Zimbabwe.

Director & Head Coach

Mr Danny Jim

1992 Zimbabwean Premier Soccer League champion who played for Black Aces, Arcadia United and Air Zimbabwe Jets. Brings elite-level experience and technical mastery to building pathways into professional football.

Secretary-General

Mrs Jessie Bore

Ensures the club follows sound corporate governance for viability and sustainability. A former journalist, she brings visibility, storytelling and resource attraction to grassroots football.

Child safety

Safeguarding, consent & privacy.

DRAFT — for Mafera FC to review and approve before publishing as final. This is a summary, not legal advice.

Safeguarding & child protection

Children come first.

Mafera FC works with children aged 9–20. The safety and welfare of every child is more important than football results.

Our commitment

We provide a safe, respectful environment. No child is bullied, abused, or excluded. Coaches and volunteers treat every child fairly and with dignity.

Who to contact

If you are worried about a child, speak to the club’s safeguarding contact / coach immediately, or message the club on WhatsApp +263 71 940 2785. Do not wait.

Coaches & volunteers

Coaches must not be alone with a child in private, must not contact children privately on social media, and must follow the club’s code of conduct. [Club to confirm: safeguarding officer name + phone]

Status: DRAFT. Club to confirm safeguarding officer, reporting steps, and code of conduct before this page is marked Final.

Parental consent — photos & player info

Photos & player information.

We do NOT publish a child’s photo, full name, or personal details without parental / guardian consent.

Parents / guardians: by allowing your child to join Mafera FC, please tell the club in writing (WhatsApp or signed form) if you:

  • DO consent to photos / videos of your child being used on this website and on Facebook — Mafera FC, for club news and promotion, OR
  • DO NOT consent — we will not publish photos of your child, and will blur / exclude them from group photos where possible.

We only publish: first name + surname initial (e.g. “Tinashe M.”) in squad lists, unless a parent agrees otherwise. We never publish: home address, school, phone number, date of birth, or ID number. Parents can withdraw consent at any time — message the club and we will remove the photo / info.

[Club to confirm: do you want a printed consent form at trials? Recommended: Yes.]

Privacy policy & terms of use

Privacy & terms.

What we collect: When you use the contact form, we receive the name, email, enquiry type and message you send — via WhatsApp. When you join, the club may collect name, age group, parent/guardian contact, and emergency contact.

What we use it for: Only to reply to your enquiry, organise trials / training, and run the club. We do not sell your information.

How we store it: Fixtures, news and squad lists are stored in the club’s database (Supabase). Contact messages go to WhatsApp. Do not send ID numbers or sensitive documents over WhatsApp — bring them to trials in person.

Your rights: You can ask the club to correct or delete your / your child’s information at any time — message the club on WhatsApp +263 71 940 2785.

Terms: Information on this site (fixtures, training times, squad lists) may change. Always confirm training / fixtures with the club before travelling. This website is for information only.
